items.question: What's included in a website for my business?
items.answer: Mobile-first design, Next.js and React development, organized copy, a WhatsApp button with a ready-made message, basic SEO (title and description) and going live with your domain connected. Depending on the plan, we add a form, FAQ, animations and structured data so Google can find you more easily.

items.question: How much does a website or landing page cost in Argentina?
items.answer: Plans start at USD 320 (Essential) and USD 520 (Premium). You can also request a custom demo for USD 79, deducted if you hire a plan. I'll send a clear quote on WhatsApp in under 24 hours, no fine print.

items.question: Do you do web design, development, or both?
items.answer: Both. I design the structure and the mobile-first experience; I build the site with TypeScript, Tailwind and solid performance practices. You don't just get a mockup: it goes live, loads fast and is ready to receive inquiries.

items.question: Do you only work in Buenos Aires or across Argentina?
items.answer: I work 100% remotely with clients across the country — Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Rosario, Patagonia and everywhere in between. Meetings and follow-up happen on WhatsApp or video call.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: Essential is delivered in 7 to 10 business days; Premium in 2 to 3 weeks. The custom demo takes 3 to 5 days. Timelines start once we have logo, copy and references.

items.question: Does the site include SEO to show up on Google?
items.answer: Yes. Every plan includes basic technical SEO: titles, meta description, Open Graph, sitemap, robots.txt and structured data. Premium adds advanced schema, an indexable FAQ and optimization for searches like web development, website and services in your field.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. I chose this stack because it loads fast, scales well and Google indexes it cleanly — ideal for landings and business websites.
